+        llm.collective_rpc("save_steps", args=(path,))
+    return [list(o.outputs[0].token_ids) for o in outputs], paths
+
+
+def _rel(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    a, b = a.float(), b.float()
+    return ((a - b).norm() / b.norm()).item()
+
+
+def _assert_quantiles(errs: list[float], what, median: float, p99: float) -> None:
+    assert errs, what
+    q = torch.quantile(torch.tensor(errs), torch.tensor([0.5, 0.99])).tolist()
+    # Any single token within 15%, five times what two stock runs differ by.
+    assert q[0] < median and q[1] < p99 and max(errs) < 0.15, (what, q, max(errs))
+
+
+def _check_close(got: dict, want: dict, keys: list, layers, output: bool) -> None:
+    """The kept tensors of ``keys`` on both runs, close in distribution.
+
+    Random weights amplify any difference layer by layer, and the stock paths
+    do not reproduce either: single decode tokens of two stock runs
+    differ by up to about 3%, with a median below 0.5% at every layer. Per
+    layer, the residual streams' median within 1% and 99th percentile within
+    5%. A token whose FFN input is off by 3% at layer 0 or
+    8% past it must have a near-tie top-6 routing on the stock path: it may
+    pick another expert (the low-batch experts route in the same FP32 order,
+    but their input carries the earlier differences), and its later layers
+    are exempt. A path the specialized-decode run no longer follows is off by far
+    more, on every token.
+    """
+    flipped: set = set()
+    for i in layers:
+        residual = []
+        for key in keys:
+            if key in flipped:
+                continue
+            a, b = got[key], want[key]
+            residual.append(_rel(a["residual"][i], b["residual"][i]))
+            err = _rel(a["ffn_input"][i], b["ffn_input"][i])
+            if err >= (0.03 if i == 0 else 0.08):
+                assert b["gap"][i] < (5e-3 if i == 0 else 1e-2), (i, key, "x", err)
+                flipped.add(key)
+        _assert_quantiles(residual, (i, "residual"), median=0.01, p99=0.05)
+    if output:
+        errs = [
+            _rel(got[k]["output"], want[k]["output"]) for k in keys if k not in flipped
+        ]
+        _assert_quantiles(errs, "output", median=0.02, p99=0.08)
+    assert len(flipped) <= len(keys) // 4, sorted(flipped)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.distributed(num_gpus=4)
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_device_capability(103),
+    reason="decode_backend=latency_specialized runs on GB300 (SM103)",
+)
+def test_specialized_decode_matches_the_model(vllm_runner, tmp_path):
+    if torch.accelerator.device_count() < 4:
+        pytest.skip("needs four GPUs")
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+    # Distinct prompt lengths past both ratios' 512 compressed entries.
+    lens = (torch.randperm(900, generator=g)[:12] + 1100).tolist()
+    prompts = [torch.randint(1000, 60000, (n,), generator=g).tolist() for n in lens]
+    # More tokens than the prefill steps decode (at most 6 a step), so all
+    # requests decode together; the last runs on alone.
+    max_tokens = [60 + 2 * i for i in range(len(prompts) - 1)] + [120]
+
+    on, paths_on = _serve(vllm_runner, True, prompts, max_tokens, f"{tmp_path}/on")
+    off, paths_off = _serve(vllm_runner, False, prompts, max_tokens, f"{tmp_path}/off")
+
+    # The executors run the target and DSpark draft models over their stock
+    # layers, with every MoE layer on the low-batch GEMMs (the target's
+    # deferring), and the draft samples on the fused and sharded samplers.
+    for rank in paths_on:
+        assert rank["decode"] == "SpecializedDecode", rank
+        assert rank["executor_sublayers"] > 0, "no step ran the executor"
+        assert rank["draft_sublayers"] > 0, "no draft step ran the executor"
+        assert rank["draft_decode"] == "DraftDecode", rank
+        assert rank["model_state"] == "DeepseekV41SpecializedDecodeModelState", rank
+        assert rank["routed_experts"] == [True] * len(LAYERS), rank
+        assert rank["draft_routed_experts"] == [True] * len(rank["draft_attention"])
+        assert rank["logits"] == ["SpecializedDecodeLogitsProcessor"], rank
+        assert rank["draft_logits"] == "SpecializedDecodeLogitsProcessor", rank
+        assert rank["metadata_graphs"] > 0, rank
+        assert rank["fused_mhc_max_rows"] == FUSED_MHC_MAX_ROWS, rank
+        assert rank["markov_samplers"] == [True, True], rank
+        assert rank["post_forward_graphs"], rank
+    for rank in paths_off:
+        assert rank["decode"] == "NoneType", rank
+        assert rank["executor_sublayers"] == 0, rank
+        assert rank["draft_sublayers"] == 0, rank
+        assert rank["draft_decode"] == "NoneType", rank
+        assert rank["model_state"] == "DeepseekV41ModelState", rank
+        assert rank["logits"] == ["LogitsProcessor"], rank
+        assert rank["draft_logits"] == "LogitsProcessor", rank
+        assert rank["metadata_graphs"] == 0, rank
+        assert rank["markov_samplers"] == [False, False], rank
+        assert not rank["post_forward_graphs"], rank
+    stock = ("attention", "ffn", "stock_fused_mhc_max_rows", "draft_attention")
+    for key in stock:
+        assert paths_on[0][key] == paths_off[0][key], key
+    assert paths_on[0]["attention"] == ["DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention"] * 5
+
+    got_steps = torch.load(f"{tmp_path}/on")
+    want_steps = torch.load(f"{tmp_path}/off")
+
+    # The decode steps covered every per-step gate on the specialized-decode run.
+    full = [s for s in got_steps if s["full"]]
+    assert {s["requests"] for s in full} >= {1, 12}, full
+    # 5 to 8 requests replay the 48-row graph, the largest whose next mHC
+    # coefficients run on the side stream.
+    assert any(5 <= s["requests"] <= 8 for s in full), "no 48-row FULL step"
+    assert any(s["padded_rows"] > s["rows"] for s in full), "no padded FULL step"
+    assert any(s["rows"] > 48 for s in full), "no FULL step above 48 rows"
+    assert all(s["post_forward"] is not None for s in got_steps), "a step not sampled"
+    assert any(s["post_forward"] == "replay" for s in full), "no post-forward replay"
+    assert all(s["post_forward"] == "eager" for s in want_steps)
+
+    def merged(steps):
+        rows: dict = {}
+        for step in steps:
+            rows.update(step.get("tokens", {}))
+        return rows
+
+    # A decode token's inputs match when the greedy tokens before it agree;
+    # a prefill token's (a key of prompt and position) always do.
+    def same_context(key) -> bool:
+        if len(key) == 2:
+            return True
+        prompt, position, step_ids = key
+        generated = position - lens[prompt] - (len(step_ids) - 1)
+        return on[prompt][: generated + 1] == off[prompt][: generated + 1]
+
+    # Mixed steps run the stock layers on both runs.
+    assert any(
+        s["has_prefill"] and any(len(key) == 3 for key in s.get("tokens", {}))
+        for s in got_steps
+    ), "no decode token in a mixed step"
+    got, want = merged(got_steps), merged(want_steps)
+    keys = sorted(k for k in got.keys() & want.keys() if same_context(k))
+    decode = [k for k in keys if len(k) == 3]
+    prefill = [k for k in keys if len(k) == 2]
+    assert len(decode) >= (DRAFTS + 1) * len(prompts), len(decode)
+    assert len(prefill) > sum(lens) // (2 * PREFILL_SAMPLE), len(prefill)
+    _check_close(got, want, decode, LAYERS, output=True)
+    replay_start = paths_on[0]["decoder_replay_start"]
+    assert replay_start == paths_off[0]["decoder_replay_start"]
+    _check_close(got, want, prefill, range(replay_start), output=False)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Cross-rank numerics of the DeepSeek-V4.1 specialized decode at TP4.
+
+Each check runs one rank late, so a missing wait reads a peer's stale data:
+
+* the fused all-reduce + mHC at 1, 6, 48 and 384 rows (its whole capacity),
+  plain, with the MXFP8 layer input, with a deferred MoE finalize and
+  residual-only, bitwise against the separate all-reduce and mHC kernels;
+* the executor's sublayer boundary on it, with the next mHC coefficients on
+  the side stream and inline, against the separate kernels and the stock mHC
+  pre;
+* the ``wo_b`` GEMM that publishes into the fused kernel's mailbox, per
+  split-K tactic, bitwise against FlashInfer's GEMM plus the separate publish;
+* logits gathered with the custom all-gather, bitwise against NCCL;
+* the row-sharded decode indexer against the replicated one (equal top-k
+  sets up to exactly tied scores);
+* one CUDA graph of all of these, replayed ``REPLAYS`` times bitwise.
+
+Needs four SM100-family GPUs with NVLink multicast and flashinfer-python
+0.7.2; about 5 minutes. For a race stress run, run this file as a module
+(``python -m tests.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.test_numerics``)
+with ``--replays 100000``.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import importlib.metadata
+import os
+import tempfile
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+TP = 4
+HIDDEN, HC, TOP_K = 5120, 4, 6
+CAPACITY = 384
+REPLAYS = 300
+LATE_CYCLES = 20_000
+
+
+def _late(rank: int, step: int) -> None:
+    """Delay one rank per step, a different one each step."""
+    if rank == step % TP:
+        torch.cuda._sleep(LATE_CYCLES)
+
+
+def _randn(generator, *shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16):
+    return torch.randn(*shape, generator=generator, device="cuda").to(dtype)
+
+
+def _mix(rows: int):
+    """The replicated mHC inputs of one boundary, equal on every rank."""
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(rows)
+    return dict(
+        residual=_randn(generator, rows, HC, HIDDEN),
+        post=torch.rand(rows, HC, generator=generator, device="cuda"),
+        comb=_randn(generator, rows, HC, HC, dtype=torch.float32) * 0.1,
+        pre=torch.rand(rows, HC, generator=generator, device="cuda"),
+        norm_weight=_randn(generator, HIDDEN),
+        norm_eps=1e-6,
+    )
+
+
+def _partial(rows: int, rank: int, seed: int = 0) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """This rank's partial sum, with +0/-0 pairs that look like the Lamport
+    sentinel."""
+    x = _randn(
+        torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed + 97 * rank), rows, HIDDEN
+    )
+    x[:, :16] = 0
+    x[:, 9:16:2] = -0.0
+    return x
+
+
+def _moe_partial(rows: int, rank: int):
+    """An unfinalized MoE output (padded permuted GEMM2 rows, routing with a
+    route to an expert this rank does not hold) and its shared output."""
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(7 + rank)
+    num_rows = rows * TOP_K + 5
+    gemm2 = _randn(generator, num_rows, HIDDEN)
+    permuted = torch.randperm(num_rows, generator=generator, device="cuda")
+    permuted = permuted[: rows * TOP_K].view(rows, TOP_K).int()
+    permuted[0, -1] = -1
+    weights = torch.rand(rows, TOP_K, generator=generator, device="cuda")
+    return gemm2, weights, permuted, _randn(generator, rows, HIDDEN)
+
+
+def _fma_finalize(gemm2, weights, permuted, shared) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """One FP32 FMA per route in route order, the shared add, one rounding."""
+    acc = torch.zeros(shared.shape, device="cuda")
+    for k in range(TOP_K):
+        valid = (permuted[:, k] >= 0).unsqueeze(-1)
+        rows = gemm2[permuted[:, k].clamp_min(0).long()].float()
+        torch.addcmul(
+            acc,
+            torch.where(valid, rows, 0.0),
+            torch.where(valid, weights[:, k : k + 1], 0.0),
+            out=acc,
+        )
+    return (acc + shared.float()).bfloat16()
+
+
+def _assert_equal(got, want, what):
+    for a, b in zip(got, want):
+        if a is None or b is None:
+            assert a is None and b is None, what
+        else:
+            assert torch.equal(a.view(torch.uint8), b.view(torch.uint8)), what
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------- fused all-reduce + mHC
+
+
+def _check_all_reduce_mhc(arm, rank):
+    from tests.distributed.test_custom_all_reduce import (
+        _bf16_ulps,
+        _unfused_all_reduce_mhc,
+    )
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.moe_output import (
+        MoEOutput,
+        UnfinalizedMoEOutput,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+        mxfp8_e4m3_quantize,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.boundary.boundary import (
+        Boundaries,
+        BoundaryState,
+        empty_quantized_layer_input,
+    )
+
+    boundaries = Boundaries(arm, torch.cuda.Stream())
+    step = 0
+    for rows in (1, 6, 48, 384):
+        mix = _mix(rows)
+        x = _partial(rows, rank)
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+        streams, layer_input = arm(x, **mix)
+        peers = get_tp_group().all_gather(x, dim=0).view(TP, rows, HIDDEN)
+        reference = _unfused_all_reduce_mhc(peers, *mix.values())
+        # The RMSNorm sums squares in another order, with an approximate rsqrt.
+        assert torch.equal(streams, reference[0]), rows
+        assert _bf16_ulps(layer_input, reference[1]) <= 1, rows
+
+        # The layer input also as MXFP8, as fused_wqa_wkv would quantize it.
+        quantized = empty_quantized_layer_input(rows, HIDDEN, x.device)
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+        out = arm(x, **mix, mxfp8_out=(quantized.data, quantized.scale))
+        _assert_equal(out, (streams, layer_input), f"MXFP8 output, {rows} rows")
+        data, scale = mxfp8_e4m3_quantize(layer_input, is_sf_swizzled_layout=True)
+        _assert_equal(
+            (quantized.data, quantized.scale),
+            (data, scale.reshape(-1)),
+            f"MXFP8 layer input, {rows} rows",
+        )
+
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+        out = arm(x, mix["residual"], mix["post"], mix["comb"], None, None, 1e-6)
+        _assert_equal(out, (streams, None), f"residual only, {rows} rows")
+        # The DSpark draft's last layer: a plain partial, residual-only.
+        state = BoundaryState(mix["residual"], mix["post"], mix["comb"], mix["pre"], x)
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+        got = boundaries.post_only(state, fuse_partial=True)
+        _assert_equal((got,), (streams,), f"residual-only partial, {rows} rows")
+
+        # A deferred MoE finalize reduces as the plain call on the finalized
+        # sum; also residual-only, at an Engram or the last layer.
+        gemm2, weights, permuted, shared = _moe_partial(rows, rank)
+        finalized = _fma_finalize(gemm2, weights, permuted, shared)
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+        want = arm(finalized, **mix)
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+        got = arm.finalize(gemm2, weights, permuted, shared, *mix.values())
+        _assert_equal(got, want, f"finalize, {rows} rows")
+        moe_output = MoEOutput(
+            UnfinalizedMoEOutput(
+                gemm2_permuted=gemm2,
+                expert_weights=weights,
+                expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx=permuted,
+            ),
+            shared_output=shared,
+        )
+        state = BoundaryState(
+            mix["residual"], mix["post"], mix["comb"], mix["pre"], moe_output
+        )
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+        got = boundaries.post_only(state)
+        _assert_equal((got,), want[:1], f"residual-only finalize, {rows} rows")
+
+
+def _check_boundaries(arm, rank):
+    """``Boundaries.sublayer`` on a partial sum and on a deferred MoE output,
+    with the next coefficients on the side stream and inline: the streams
+    bitwise against the separate all-reduce and mHC post, the mixes bitwise
+    against the stock mHC pre on those streams, and the layer input within
+    the fused RMSNorm's ulp of it."""
+    from tests.distributed.test_custom_all_reduce import (
+        _bf16_ulps,
+        _unfused_all_reduce_mhc,
+    )
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.moe_output import (
+        MoEOutput,
+        UnfinalizedMoEOutput,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.ops.mhc import mhc_pre_delayed_overlap
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.boundary.boundary import (
+        Boundaries,
+        BoundaryState,
+    )
+
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(3)  # equal on all ranks
+    mix_size = HC * (HC + 2)
+    fn = torch.randn(mix_size, HC * HIDDEN, generator=generator, device="cuda") * 0.02
+    scale = torch.tensor([0.5, 0.25, 1.0], device="cuda")
+    base = torch.randn(mix_size, generator=generator, device="cuda")
+    side = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    boundaries = Boundaries(arm, side)
+    step = 0
+    for rows in (1, 6, 48, 384):
+        mix = _mix(rows)
+        layer = SimpleNamespace(
+            hc_attn_fn=fn,
+            hc_attn_scale=scale,
+            hc_attn_base=base,
+            attn_norm=SimpleNamespace(weight=mix["norm_weight"], variance_epsilon=1e-6),
+            rms_norm_eps=1e-6,
+            hc_eps=1e-6,
+            hc_post_alpha=2.0,
+            hc_sinkhorn_iters=20,
+        )
+        gemm2, weights, permuted, shared = _moe_partial(rows, rank)
+        deferred = MoEOutput(
+            UnfinalizedMoEOutput(
+                gemm2_permuted=gemm2,
+                expert_weights=weights,
+                expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx=permuted,
+            ),
+            shared_output=shared,
+        )
+        # (what the sublayer left, the partial sum it amounts to)
+        cases = (
+            ("partial", _partial(rows, rank), _partial(rows, rank)),
+            ("deferred", deferred, _fma_finalize(gemm2, weights, permuted, shared)),
+        )
+        for name, pending, finalized in cases:
+            peers = get_tp_group().all_gather(finalized, dim=0)
+            streams, _ = _unfused_all_reduce_mhc(
+                peers.view(TP, rows, HIDDEN), *mix.values()
+            )
+            want = mhc_pre_delayed_overlap(
+                streams,
+                fn,
+                scale,
+                base,
+                1e-6,
+                1e-6,
+                1e-6,
+                2.0,
+                20,
+                pre_mix=mix["pre"],
+                norm_weight=mix["norm_weight"],
+                norm_eps=1e-6,
+                stream=side,
+            )
+            torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(side)
+            for side_stream in (True, False):
+                what = f"{name}, {rows} rows, side stream {side_stream}"
+                state = BoundaryState(
+                    mix["residual"], mix["post"], mix["comb"], mix["pre"], pending
+                )
+                decode_step = SimpleNamespace(side_stream=side_stream)
+                _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+                state, layer_input, _, aux = boundaries.sublayer(
+                    layer, False, state, decode_step, capture_aux=True
+                )
+                boundaries.join(decode_step)
+                _assert_equal(
+                    (state.residual, aux),
+                    (streams, streams.mean(dim=1)),
+                    f"streams, {what}",
+                )
+                _assert_equal(
+                    (state.post, state.comb, state.pre),
+                    (want[0], want[1], want[3]),
+                    f"mixes, {what}",
+                )
+                assert _bf16_ulps(layer_input, want[2]) <= 1, what
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------- publishing wo_b
+
+WO_B_K = 2048  # o_lora_rank x local groups at TP4
+
+
+def _wo_b(rank: int, index: int):
+    """A ``wo_b`` linear with its weights processed for the low-latency
+    MXFP8 kernel, different on each rank."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.mxfp8.flashinfer import (
+        FlashInferCutedslMxfp8LinearKernel,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.mxfp8.Mxfp8LinearKernel import (
+        Mxfp8LinearLayerConfig,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+        mxfp8_e4m3_quantize,
+    )
+
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1000 * rank + index)
+    w = _randn(generator, HIDDEN, WO_B_K, dtype=torch.float32) / WO_B_K**0.5
+    w_q, w_s = mxfp8_e4m3_quantize(w.bfloat16(), is_sf_swizzled_layout=False)
+    linear = torch.nn.Module()
+    linear.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(w_q, requires_grad=False)
+    linear.weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(
+        w_s.view(HIDDEN, WO_B_K // 32), requires_grad=False
+    )
+    kernel = FlashInferCutedslMxfp8LinearKernel(
+        Mxfp8LinearLayerConfig((HIDDEN, WO_B_K))
+    )
+    kernel.process_weights_after_loading(linear)
+    linear.quant_method = SimpleNamespace(kernel=kernel)
+    return linear
+
+
+def _attention_output(rows: int, rank: int):
+    """``wo_b``'s MXFP8 input as the fused WO-A kernel emits it, with a zero
+    row (zero outputs, whose negative zeros the publish clears)."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fusion.quant_activation import (
+        QuantizedActivation,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+        mxfp8_e4m3_quantize,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import (
+        kMxfp8Dynamic,
+    )
+
+    x = _randn(torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(rank), rows, WO_B_K)
+    x[-1] = 0
+    data, scale = mxfp8_e4m3_quantize(x, is_sf_swizzled_layout=True)
+    return QuantizedActivation(
+        data, scale.reshape(-1), torch.bfloat16, x.shape, kMxfp8Dynamic
+    )
+
+
+def _flashinfer_wo_b(linear, qa, tactic):
+    """FlashInfer's low-latency MXFP8 GEMM with ``tactic`` (None: the
+    default), and the valid tactics."""
+    from flashinfer.gemm import gemm_base
+
+    out = torch.empty(qa.data.shape[0], HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability()
+    runner = gemm_base._cutedsl_low_latency_blockscaled_gemm_runner(
+        major * 10 + minor, True
+    )
+    workspace = gemm_base._get_cache_buf(
+        "mm_mxfp8_workspace", gemm_base.DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_SIZE, out.device
+    )
+    inputs = [
+        qa.data,
+        linear.weight,
+        qa.scale,
+        linear.weight_scale,
+        torch.bfloat16,
+        out,
+        workspace,
+    ]
+    runner.forward(inputs, tactic=tactic)
+    return out, [tuple(t) for t in runner.get_valid_tactics(inputs, None)]
+
+

+# ---------------------------------------------------- row-sharded indexer
+
+CONTEXTS = (84_000, 163_000, 300_000, 360_000, 406_000, 490_000, 556_000, 648_000)
+NEXT_N = 6  # rows per request: DSpark verification of five drafts
+INDEX_HEADS, INDEX_HEAD_DIM, INDEX_TOPK = 32, 128, 512
+CANDIDATE_BLOCKS, CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE = 2048, 8
+MAX_MODEL_LEN = 655_360
+PAGE_TOKENS = 128
+ROPE_POSITIONS = 2048
+# (requests, of which trailing padding requests).
+INDEX_BATCHES = ((8, 0), (32, 10))
+# A dense index source (ratio 2) and the candidate source (ratio 1).
+INDEX_LAYERS = ((2, False), (1, True))
+
+
+def _index_keys(ratio: int, generator):
+    """A paged MXFP4 indexer key cache holding every context once."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.ops import indexer_k_norm_rope_store
+
+    row_bytes = INDEX_HEAD_DIM // 2 + INDEX_HEAD_DIM // 32
+    page_states = PAGE_TOKENS // ratio
+    pages = [-(-(ctx // ratio) // page_states) for ctx in CONTEXTS]
+    page_bytes = -(-(page_states * row_bytes) // 512) * 512
+    storage = torch.empty(sum(pages), page_bytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    cache = storage.as_strided(
+        (sum(pages), page_states, row_bytes), (page_bytes, row_bytes, 1)
+    )
+    angles = torch.rand(2 * ROPE_POSITIONS, 32, generator=generator, device="cuda")
+    cos_sin = torch.cat((angles.cos(), angles.sin()), dim=-1)
+    norm_weight = torch.ones(INDEX_HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    num_slots = sum(pages) * page_states
+    for first in range(0, num_slots, 1 << 20):
+        slots = torch.arange(first, min(first + (1 << 20), num_slots), device="cuda")
+        k_pre = _randn(generator, slots.numel(), INDEX_HEAD_DIM)
+        positions = (slots % ROPE_POSITIONS) * ratio + ratio - 1
+        indexer_k_norm_rope_store(
+            k_pre, positions, cos_sin, norm_weight, 1e-6, cache, slots, ratio, True
+        )
+    starts = [sum(pages[:i]) for i in range(len(pages))]
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        cache=cache, page_states=page_states, pages=pages, starts=starts
+    )
+
+
+def _decode_step(requests, padding, ratio, keys, generator):
+    """The indexer metadata and queries of a pure-decode step of ``NEXT_N``
+    rows per request; padding requests have rows of length 0."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.ops import fused_indexer_q_rope_quant
+    from vllm.utils.deep_gemm import get_paged_mqa_logits_metadata
+    from vllm.utils.platform_utils import num_compute_units
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.indexer import (
+        DeepSeekV32IndexerDecodeMetadata,
+        DeepseekV32IndexerMetadata,
+    )
+
+    rows = requests * NEXT_N
+    real = requests - padding
+    lens, tables, indices = [], [], []
+    for request in range(real):
+        i = request % len(CONTEXTS)
+        table = torch.zeros(max(keys.pages), dtype=torch.int32)
+        table[: keys.pages[i]] = torch.arange(
+            keys.starts[i], keys.starts[i] + keys.pages[i]
+        )
+        for j in range(NEXT_N):
+            lens.append((CONTEXTS[i] - NEXT_N + j + 1) // ratio)
+            tables.append(table)
+            indices.append(request)
+    for row in range(real * NEXT_N, rows):
+        # Padding rows: no context, each its own index.
+        lens.append(0)
+        tables.append(torch.zeros(max(keys.pages), dtype=torch.int32))
+        indices.append(requests + row - real * NEXT_N)
+    seq_lens = torch.tensor(lens, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").unsqueeze(1)
+    indices = torch.tensor(indices, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    decode = DeepSeekV32IndexerDecodeMetadata(
+        block_table=torch.stack(tables).cuda(),
+        seq_lens=seq_lens,
+        decode_lens=torch.ones(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        requires_padding=False,
+        schedule_metadata=get_paged_mqa_logits_metadata(
+            seq_lens, keys.page_states, num_compute_units(), indices=indices
+        ),
+        indices=indices,
+    )
+    metadata = DeepseekV32IndexerMetadata(
+        seq_lens=torch.zeros(requests, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        max_seq_len=max(CONTEXTS),
+        slot_mapping=torch.zeros(rows, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda"),
+        num_decodes=requests,
+        num_decode_tokens=rows,
+        num_prefills=0,
+        num_prefill_tokens=0,
+        decode=decode,
+    )
+    angles = torch.linspace(0, 6.3, ROPE_POSITIONS * 32, device="cuda").view(-1, 32)
+    (q, q_scale), weights = fused_indexer_q_rope_quant(
+        torch.arange(rows, device="cuda") + 100,
+        _randn(generator, rows, INDEX_HEADS, INDEX_HEAD_DIM),
+        torch.cat((angles.cos(), angles.sin()), dim=-1),
+        _randn(generator, rows, INDEX_HEADS),
+        INDEX_HEAD_DIM**-0.5,
+        INDEX_HEADS**-0.5,
+        use_fp4=True,
+        weights_out_dtype=torch.float32,
+    )
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        metadata=metadata, rows=rows, q=(q, q_scale), weights=weights
+    )
+
+
+def _indexer(keys, ratio, candidates):
+    """The decode indexer of a layer, writing ``topk`` (and ``candidates``)."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.sparse_attn_indexer import SparseAttnIndexer
+
+    rows = max(r for r, _ in INDEX_BATCHES) * NEXT_N
+    return SparseAttnIndexer(
+        SimpleNamespace(prefix="indexer", kv_cache=keys.cache),
+        quant_block_size=128,
+        scale_fmt="ue8m0",
+        topk_tokens=INDEX_TOPK,
+        head_dim=INDEX_HEAD_DIM,
+        max_model_len=MAX_MODEL_LEN // ratio,
+        max_total_seq_len=0,
+        topk_indices_buffer=torch.empty(
+            rows, INDEX_TOPK, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"
+        ),
+        skip_k_cache_insert=True,
+        use_fp4_cache=True,
+        compress_ratio=ratio,
+        candidate_blocks=torch.empty(
+            rows, CANDIDATE_BLOCKS, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"
+        )
+        if candidates
+        else None,
+        candidate_block_size=CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE,
+        candidate_write=candidates,
+    )
+
+
+def _run_indexer(indexer, step, stock=False):
+    """One decode forward, stock or the executor's; returns the top-k and
+    candidate rows it wrote."""
+    from vllm.forward_context import ForwardContext, override_forward_context
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.attention.indexer import (
+        decode_rows,
+    )
+
+    hidden = torch.empty(step.rows, 1, device="cuda")
+    with override_forward_context(ForwardContext({}, {"indexer": step.metadata}, {})):
+        if stock:
+            indexer.forward_cuda(hidden, step.q, None, step.weights)
+        else:
+            decode_rows(indexer, hidden, step.q, step.weights)
+    candidates = indexer.candidate_blocks
+    return (
+        indexer.topk_indices_buffer[: step.rows],
+        None if candidates is None else candidates[: step.rows],
+    )
+
+
+def _index_scores(indexer, step):
+    """The replicated logits, and the candidate block scores (newest block
+    pinned) the candidate selection ranks."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.sparse_attn_indexer import (
+        as_fp32_logits,
+        kv_cache_as_quant_view,
+    )
+    from vllm.utils.deep_gemm import fp8_fp4_paged_mqa_logits, mqa_logits_mx_inputs
+
+    decode = step.metadata.decode
+    q, q_scale = step.q
+    q = q.unsqueeze(1).view(torch.int8)
+    q_scale, weights = mqa_logits_mx_inputs(q, q_scale.unsqueeze(1), step.weights)
+    ends = decode.seq_lens.view(-1)
+    logits = as_fp32_logits(
+        fp8_fp4_paged_mqa_logits(
+            (q, q_scale),
+            kv_cache_as_quant_view(indexer.k_cache.kv_cache, INDEX_HEAD_DIM, True),
+            weights,
+            decode.seq_lens,
+            decode.block_table,
+            decode.schedule_metadata,
+            max_model_len=indexer.max_model_len,
+            indices=decode.indices,
+        ),
+        ends,
+    )
+    width = logits.shape[1]
+    valid = logits.masked_fill(
+        torch.arange(width, device="cuda") >= ends.unsqueeze(1), float("-inf")
+    )
+    valid = torch.nn.functional.pad(
+        valid, (0, -width % CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE), value=float("-inf")
+    )
+    blocks = valid.view(step.rows, -1, CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE).amax(-1)
+    live = (ends > 0).nonzero().view(-1)
+    blocks[live, ((ends[live] - 1) // CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE).long()] = float("inf")
+    return logits, blocks
+
+
+def _assert_same_sets(got, want, scores, limits, k, what):
+    """Per row: equal index sets, except that indices whose scores tie
+    exactly at the selection boundary may be swapped; padding rows are -1."""
+    got, want, limits = got.cpu(), want.cpu(), limits.cpu()
+    for row in range(got.shape[0]):
+        g = got[row][got[row] >= 0].tolist()
+        w = want[row][want[row] >= 0].tolist()
+        assert len(set(g)) == len(g) == min(int(limits[row]), k), (what, row)
+        assert (got[row][got[row] < 0] == -1).all(), (what, row)
+        if set(g) != set(w):
+            row_scores = scores[row]
+            boundary = row_scores[torch.tensor(w, device="cuda")].min()
+            swapped = torch.tensor(sorted(set(g) ^ set(w)), device="cuda")
+            assert (row_scores[swapped] == boundary).all(), (what, row)
+
+
+def _check_row_sharded_indexer(rank):
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)  # equal on all ranks
+    keys = {ratio: _index_keys(ratio, generator) for ratio, _ in INDEX_LAYERS}
+    for requests, padding in INDEX_BATCHES:
+        for ratio, candidates in INDEX_LAYERS:
+            what = f"{requests} requests ({padding} padding), ratio {ratio}"
+            generator.manual_seed(1000 * requests + ratio)
+            step = _decode_step(requests, padding, ratio, keys[ratio], generator)
+            indexer = _indexer(keys[ratio], ratio, candidates)
+            want = [
+                t if t is None else t.clone()
+                for t in _run_indexer(indexer, step, stock=True)
+            ]
+            _late(rank, requests)
+            got = _run_indexer(indexer, step)
+            logits, blocks = _index_scores(indexer, step)
+            ends = step.metadata.decode.seq_lens.view(-1)
+            _assert_same_sets(got[0], want[0], logits, ends, INDEX_TOPK, what)
+            if candidates:
+                block_ends = (ends + CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) // CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE
+                _assert_same_sets(
+                    got[1], want[1], blocks, block_ends, CANDIDATE_BLOCKS, what
+                )
+    return keys
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------- graph replays
+
+
+def _check_replays(arm, publisher, keys, rank, replays):
+    """One CUDA graph of a decode step's collectives: a published ``wo_b``
+    boundary, a deferred finalize with the MXFP8 layer input, a residual-only
+    boundary, a full-capacity boundary and the row-sharded indexer, with the
+    ranks arriving in a fixed skew. Every replay must equal the first; the
+    indexer's top-k rows as sets up to boundary ties, since top-k writes them
+    in any order and picks any of the indices that tie at the boundary."""
+    from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import graph_capture
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.boundary.boundary import (
+        empty_quantized_layer_input,
+    )
+
+    linear = _wo_b(rank, 0)
+    qa = _attention_output(6, rank)
+    moe = _moe_partial(6, rank)
+    quantized = empty_quantized_layer_input(6, HIDDEN, qa.data.device)
+    mixes = {rows: _mix(rows) for rows in (6, 48, CAPACITY)}
+    partials = {rows: _partial(rows, rank, seed=rows) for rows in (48, CAPACITY)}
+    step = _decode_step(8, 0, 2, keys[2], torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1))
+    indexer = _indexer(keys[2], 2, candidates=False)
+
+    def decode_step():
+        torch.cuda._sleep(rank * LATE_CYCLES)
+        out = list(arm(publisher(linear, qa), **mixes[6]))
+        out += arm.finalize(
+            *moe, *mixes[6].values(), mxfp8_out=(quantized.data, quantized.scale)
+        )
+        out += [quantized.data, quantized.scale]
+        mix = mixes[48]
+        streams, _ = arm(
+            partials[48], mix["residual"], mix["post"], mix["comb"], None, None, 1e-6
+        )
+        out.append(streams)
+        out += arm(partials[CAPACITY], **mixes[CAPACITY])
+        out.append(_run_indexer(indexer, step)[0])
+        return [t for t in out if t is not None]
+
+    with graph_capture(device=torch.device("cuda")) as context:
+        decode_step()
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=context.stream):
+            outputs = decode_step()
+    graph.replay()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    *collectives, topk = outputs
+    first = [t.clone() for t in collectives]
+    first_topk = topk.clone()
+    logits, _ = _index_scores(indexer, step)
+    ends = step.metadata.decode.seq_lens.view(-1)
+    for i in range(replays):
+        graph.replay()
+        if i % 50 == 49 or i == replays - 1:
+            _assert_equal(collectives, first, f"replay {i}")
+            _assert_same_sets(topk, first_topk, logits, ends, INDEX_TOPK, f"replay {i}")
+

+def _worker(rank: int, port: int, replays: int, skip_path: str) -> None:

+        BoundaryAllReduce,
+    )

+        PublishingMxfp8Linear,
+    )

+            parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                tensor_parallel_size=TP, enable_expert_parallel=False

+            supported, torch.distributed.ReduceOp.MIN, get_tp_group().cpu_group
+        )

+        assert arm.capacity == CAPACITY and arm.quantize_layer_input

+def run(replays: int) -> str | None:
+    """Run the checks on four GPUs; returns why they were skipped, if so."""
+    from vllm.utils.network_utils import get_open_port

+        )
+        if os.path.exists(skip_path):
+            with open(skip_path) as f:
+                return f.read()
+    return None

+# DeepSeek-V4.1 specialized decode (NVIDIA)
+
+A decode executor for small decode batches of DeepSeek-V4.1 on GB300, enabled
+with `--additional-config '{"decode_backend": "latency_specialized"}'` (the
+default, `auto`, keeps the stock decode). With it off, the model runs exactly as
+without this package. One executor runs the target model and another the
+DSpark draft model, on the target's kernels and streams.
+
+## Scope
+
+`specialized_decode_config` (`__init__.py`) reads the setting once, when the
+target model is built. Any deployment other than the one below raises at
+startup on every TP rank with the missing requirements:
+
+- GPU: GB300 (SM103).
+- Runner: Model Runner V2.
+- Parallelism: TP=4; no pipeline, data, expert or context parallelism, no
+  micro-batching.
+- Speculative decoding: DSpark, without adaptive verification.
+- Attention: `FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41`, fp8 KV cache, MXFP4 indexer with
+  sparse logits.
+- CUDA graphs: FULL graphs for decode batches only (`FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` or
+  `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`).
+- No `torch.compile` of the model, no sleep mode.
+- No LoRA, KV transfer or batch invariance.
+- DeepGEMM and NVLink multicast for the fused all-reduce + mHC.
+
+This check runs once, at startup. The configuration is the same on every
+rank, but the last requirement is probed per rank: the custom all-reduce sets
+up its NVLink multicast buffers on each rank and catches a failure there, so
+one rank can be without them while the others have them. The ranks' results
+are therefore combined with a MIN all-reduce over the TP group: if any rank
+misses a requirement, every rank raises, rather than some ranks running the
+specialized decode and others the stock one, which issue different
+collectives and would hang. Which forward steps use the executor depends
+only on the batch, which every TP rank receives identically, so that needs no
+collective.
+
+Four features run only on flashinfer-python 0.7.2 (`FLASHINFER_VERSION`, the
+version `requirements/cuda.txt` pins). Three use FlashInfer internals:
+
+- the publishing `wo_b` GEMM: the CuTe DSL low-latency block-scaled GEMM
+  kernel, and `mm_mxfp8`'s private runner and tuning config
+  (`flashinfer.gemm.gemm_base`) to look up its tuned tactic;
+- the fused kernel's MXFP8 layer input: the CuTe DSL MXFP8 quantize helpers
+  (`flashinfer.quantization.quantization_cute_dsl_utils`,
+  `flashinfer.cute_dsl.fp4_common`);
+- the pinned MXFP8 GEMM tactics: the low-latency GEMM's `autotune_tactics`.
+
+The fourth, the sparse-MLA decode's persistent KV counters, passes the
+`multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer` argument that 0.7.1 added.
+
+On any other version each logs a warning once and the executor goes without
+it; the MXFP8 GEMMs then tune over every tactic.
+
+## Structure
+
+The model state (`runtime/model_state.py`) builds the executor
+(`runtime/decode.py`) once the weights are loaded, and tunes and compiles its
+kernels (`runtime/warmup.py`) before memory profiling. For each forward, the
+model asks the executor for a `DecodeStep`; the backbone runs its embedding and
+Engram hashing as usual, then hands the decoder layers to the step. Only FULL
+CUDA graph captures of pure decode steps of up to 384 rows get one; every other
+forward runs the stock layers, which the executor does not modify.
+
+The DSpark draft model registers when it is built, and the model state builds
+its executor (`runtime/draft.py`) right after the target's, on the same fused
+kernel, mailbox and mHC side stream; the draft model's forward asks it for a
+step the same way. The model state also offers Model Runner V2 the DSpark
+post-forward CUDA graphs (`vllm/v1/worker/gpu/post_forward_cudagraph.py`).
+No capture size is required: a draft step without a FULL graph of at most 8
+rows takes no low-batch GEMM, and the model state logs once when the capture
+sizes leave no one-request draft graph.
+
+| Package | Contents |
+| --- | --- |
+| `runtime/` | The target's and the draft's executors and their per-step gates, the model state, warm-up, attention-metadata CUDA graphs |
+| `boundary/` | The mHC between sublayers on the fused all-reduce + mHC kernel, and the publishing `wo_b` GEMM |
+| `attention/` | The attention step: low-batch MXFP8 and BF16 projections, the row-sharded indexer, candidate overlap, shared sparse-index tables and the sparse-MLA decode |
+| `moe/` | The MoE step with a deferred or in-layer finalize, and the low-batch routed-expert GEMMs |
+| `engram/` | The Engram WKV ahead of the decoder layers |
+| `logits/` | The low-batch LM head and the logits gather |
+
+## Paths
+
+| Path | Steps |
+| --- | --- |
+| Fused Lamport all-reduce + mHC at every sublayer boundary; the next mHC coefficients on the side stream up to 48 rows, inline beyond | all executor steps (up to 384 rows) |
+| Every MoE finalize deferred to the next boundary's fused kernel, in a residual-only variant before an Engram layer and after the last layer | all executor steps |
+| The fused kernel also writes the attention input as MXFP8, which `fused_wqa_wkv` reads instead of quantizing again | all executor steps |
+| DSpark draft layers through the same steps, finalizing their MoE in the layer; the last layer's output in the fused kernel's residual-only variant | all draft executor steps |
+| DSpark Markov sampling in one kernel per draft position after the bias GEMM (`vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/dspark/fused_sample.py`) | probabilistic drafting without draft top-k, watermarking or adaptive verification |
+| The whole Markov chain in one cooperative kernel per rank, the Markov head sharded by vocabulary over the TP ranks (`sharded_markov.py` beside it) | batches of up to 8 request rows |
+| Sampling, the request-state update and the draft input preparation in a post-forward CUDA graph, the draft context projection beside them on a side stream | uniform decode steps without logprobs, grammar or logits processing |
+| Aux hidden-state means on the mHC side stream | up to 48 rows |
+| Routed experts on CuTe DSL routing, `tcgen05` GEMM and finalize kernels (`moe/routed_expert_gemm.py`) | 1-8 rows |
+| `fused_wqa_wkv`, `wq_b` and `wo_b` on FlashInfer's low-latency CuTe DSL MXFP8 GEMM with pinned tactics | 1-8 rows |
+| Compressor, indexer-weight and indexer `wk` projections on a low-batch BF16 GEMM; the index key store reads `wk`'s FP32 output | 1-8 rows |
+| `wo_b` stores its output into the fused kernel's mailbox, which then only collects | 1-8 rows |
+| Indexer query, compressor and index key on side streams, each joined at its first reader | all executor steps; the side projections up to `VLLM_MULTI_STREAM_GEMM_TOKEN_THRESHOLD` rows |
+| Candidate consumers' candidate expansion and MQA-logits schedule on a side stream after the candidate source's indexer | up to 16 rows |
+| Dense indexer rows sharded over the TP ranks and all-gathered | steps of at least 8 requests that TP divides |
+| Candidate blocks selected with `cooperative_topk` | up to 64 rows per rank |
+| Compressed layers sharing an index source reuse one sparse-index table; the first of them builds the other KV-cache groups' tables on a side stream | all executor steps |
+| Sparse-MLA decode launched on a KV-counter buffer zeroed once | all executor steps |
+| Engram WKV chain on a side stream right after each layer's lookup | up to 16 rows, with host-offloaded TP-only tables and a CuTe DSL MXFP8 `wkv` |
+| Attention metadata builds recorded at CUDA graph capture, one per batch shape the FULL decode graphs serve, and replayed | FULL-graph uniform decode |
+| LM head on FlashInfer's CuTe DSL BF16 GEMM | 1-16 rows |
+| Logits gathered with the custom all-gather | whenever it accepts the input |
+
+## Dispatch
+
+The executor issues cross-rank collectives, so a rank that diverged would hang
+rather than fall back. Every per-step gate reads only host state that all TP
+ranks share (row and request counts, graph mode, the attention metadata's host
+fields); nothing is read back from the GPU. The LM head and logits gather run
+outside the target's CUDA graph (Model Runner V2 computes logits eagerly),
+gated by row count and by the custom all-gather. On uniform decode steps with
+DSpark, they, the sampling and the draft input preparation are captured in a
+post-forward CUDA graph of their own.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DeepSeek-V4.1 specialized decode on NVIDIA GPUs: a decode executor over the
+stock backbone, and one over the DSpark draft model's, enabled by
+``additional_config={"decode_backend": "latency_specialized"}``.
+
+The executors run FULL-graph decode steps; every other step runs the stock
+forward. They issue cross-rank collectives, so the deployment check below is
+collective over the TP group and every per-step decision reads host state that
+all TP ranks share.
+"""
+
+import importlib.metadata
+import weakref
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from functools import cache
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm.config import CompilationMode, CUDAGraphMode, VllmConfig
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.registry import AttentionBackendEnum
+
+from ..ops.mhc import supports_mhc_all_reduce, supports_mhc_overlap
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from ..dspark import DSparkDeepseekV4ForCausalLM
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+# Rows of the executor's fused all-reduce + mHC mailbox: the largest FULL
+# decode graph at 64 requests x 6 DSpark tokens.
+FUSED_MHC_MAX_ROWS = 384
+# Rows whose next mHC coefficients run on the side stream; larger steps compute
+# them inline after the fused kernel.
+MHC_OVERLAP_MAX_ROWS = 48
+# Rows of the low-batch GEMMs: one DSpark verification step of up to 8 rows
+# (6 at one request).
+LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS = 8
+# The FlashInfer (requirements/cuda.txt) whose internals the publishing wo_b
+# GEMM, the MXFP8 layer input and the pinned MXFP8 tactics were checked
+# against. Its sparse-MLA decode takes caller-owned KV counters (since 0.7.1).
+FLASHINFER_VERSION = "0.7.2"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DecodeConfig:
+    # Tune the executor's FlashInfer GEMMs at build
+    # (kernel_config.enable_flashinfer_autotune is not False).
+    autotune: bool
+    # Compile the mHC pre-norm kernels of the executor's row counts.
+    jit_warmup: bool
+
+
+@cache
+def uses_checked_flashinfer(feature: str) -> bool:
+    """Whether the installed FlashInfer is the version whose internals
+    ``feature`` uses; logs once per feature when it is not."""
+    try:
+        version = importlib.metadata.version("flashinfer-python")
+    except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
+        version = None
+    if version == FLASHINFER_VERSION:
+        return True
+    logger.warning(
+        "DeepSeek-V4.1 specialized decode: %s needs flashinfer-python %s "
+        "(found %s); using the stock path instead.",
+        feature,
+        FLASHINFER_VERSION,
+        version,
+    )
+    return False
+
+
+def unsupported(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> list[str]:
+    """Every requirement of the specialized decode this deployment misses."""
+    parallel = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    attention = vllm_config.attention_config
+    spec = vllm_config.speculative_config
+    compilation = vllm_config.compilation_config
+    cudagraph_mode = compilation.cudagraph_mode
+    requirements = {
+        "a GB300 (SM103) GPU": current_platform.is_device_capability(103),
+        "Model Runner V2": vllm_config.use_v2_model_runner,
+        "tensor parallel size 4 without pipeline, data, expert or context "
+        "parallelism or micro-batching": (
+            parallel.tensor_parallel_size == 4
+            and parallel.pipeline_parallel_size == 1
+            and parallel.data_parallel_size == 1
+            and not parallel.enable_expert_parallel
+            and parallel.decode_context_parallel_size == 1
+            and parallel.prefill_context_parallel_size == 1
+            and not parallel.use_ubatching
+        ),
+        "DSpark speculative decoding without adaptive verification": (
+            spec is not None
+            and spec.method == "dspark"
+            and not spec.enable_adaptive_verification
+        ),
+        "the FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41 attention backend, an fp8 KV cache "
+        "and the MXFP4 indexer with sparse logits": (
+            attention.backend == AttentionBackendEnum.FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41
+            and vllm_config.cache_config.cache_dtype in ("fp8", "fp8_e4m3")
+            and attention.indexer_kv_dtype == "mxfp4"
+            and attention.indexer_sparse_logits
+        ),
+        "FULL CUDA graphs for decode batches only (FULL_AND_PIECEWISE or "
+        "FULL_DECODE_ONLY)": (
+            cudagraph_mode is not None
+            and cudagraph_mode.decode_mode() == CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+            and cudagraph_mode.mixed_mode() != CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+        ),
+        # The decode loop runs in forward; a compiled forward would trace it.
+        "no torch.compile of the model": (
+            compilation.mode != CompilationMode.STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE
+        ),
+        # The routed-expert GEMMs and the publishing wo_b bind weight addresses.
+        "no sleep mode": not vllm_config.model_config.enable_sleep_mode,
+        "no LoRA, KV transfer or batch invariance": (
+            vllm_config.lora_config is None
+            and vllm_config.kv_transfer_config is None
+            and not envs.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT
+        ),
+        "DeepGEMM and NVLink multicast for the fused all-reduce + mHC": (
+            supports_mhc_overlap(vllm_config) and supports_mhc_all_reduce(vllm_config)
+        ),
+    }
+    return [need for need, ok in requirements.items() if not ok]
+
+
+def decode_backend(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> str:
+    """``additional_config["decode_backend"]``: ``auto`` (the default, the stock
+    decode) or ``latency_specialized``."""
+    extra = vllm_config.additional_config
+    backend = extra.get("decode_backend", "auto") if isinstance(extra, dict) else "auto"
+    if backend not in ("auto", "latency_specialized"):
+        raise ValueError("Supported decode_backend values are auto/latency_specialized")
+    return backend
+
+
+def specialized_decode_config(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> DecodeConfig | None:
+    """The specialized decode settings, or None for the stock decode.
+
+    Collective over the TP group when requested: every rank raises if any rank
+    cannot run the specialized decode.
+    """
+    if decode_backend(vllm_config) == "auto":
+        return None
+    missing = unsupported(vllm_config)
+    supported = torch.tensor([0 if missing else 1], dtype=torch.int32)
+    # The NVLink multicast check is rank-local (the custom all-reduce catches a
+    # failed setup on each rank), and ranks that disagree would hang.
+    dist.all_reduce(supported, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=get_tp_group().cpu_group)
+    if not supported.item():
+        reason = "; ".join(missing) or "another tensor parallel rank to support it"
+        raise ValueError(f"decode_backend=latency_specialized needs {reason}.")
+    logger.info_once(
+        "DeepSeek-V4.1 specialized decode on, for FULL-graph decode steps of up "
+        "to %d rows.",
+        FUSED_MHC_MAX_ROWS,
+    )
+    kernel = vllm_config.kernel_config
+    return DecodeConfig(
+        autotune=kernel.enable_flashinfer_autotune is not False,
+        jit_warmup=bool(kernel.enable_jit_warmup),
+    )
+
+
+# The DSpark draft models built with decode_backend=latency_specialized and not yet
+# given an executor. The target's model state builds theirs once both models
+# are loaded, in registration order, which every TP rank shares.
+_drafts: list["weakref.ref[DSparkDeepseekV4ForCausalLM]"] = []
+
+
+def register_draft(draft: "DSparkDeepseekV4ForCausalLM") -> None:
+    """Have the target model's state build ``draft`` a decode executor."""
+    _drafts.append(weakref.ref(draft))
+
+
+def take_drafts() -> list["DSparkDeepseekV4ForCausalLM"]:
+    """The live drafts registered since the last call, in registration
+    order."""
+    drafts = [draft for ref in _drafts if (draft := ref()) is not None]
+    _drafts.clear()
+    return drafts

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Low-batch GEMMs of the attention side projections.
+
+Next to ``fused_wqa_wkv``, the kv-source layers project the attention input
+through the compressor's ``fused_wkv_wgate`` (FP32 ``kv_score``) and the
+index-source layers through the indexer's ``weights_proj``. At decode sizes
+cuBLAS runs both as a split-K GEMM plus a reduce kernel, longer than
+``fused_wqa_wkv`` itself. For low-batch FULL-graph steps they run the CuTe DSL
+``ll_bf16`` kernels instead: FP32 ``x @ W.T`` that differs from cuBLAS only in
+the K summation order. The indexer's ``wk`` (compressor latent to index key)
+takes the same kernels.
+"""
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.cute_dsl import ll_bf16
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.cute_dsl.ll_bf16 import LLBf16Gemm
+
+from .. import LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS
+
+# Below this N the split-K kernel has too few CTAs; the dot product runs.
+_DOTPROD_MAX_N = 128
+_DOTPROD_BS = 128
+
+# Per (K, N) and row count, the fastest config on GB300 where it beats the
+# default dispatch: ("dotprod", bs) or ("splitk", (split_k, num_stages)).
+_TUNED: dict[tuple[int, int], dict[int, tuple[str, int | tuple[int, int]]]] = {
+    # Compressor ratio 2 (kv + score).
+    (5120, 1024): {m: ("splitk", (4, 4)) for m in (5, 6, 7, 8)},
+    # Compressor ratio 1 (kv only).
+    (5120, 512): {5: ("dotprod", 128), 6: ("dotprod", 64), 8: ("splitk", (4, 6))},
+}
+
+
+class AuxProjectionGemm(LLBf16Gemm):
+    def dispatch(
+        self, *, M: int, K: int, N: int, output_dtype: torch.dtype = torch.float32
+    ) -> LLBf16Gemm.CompileKey:
+        tuned = _TUNED.get((K, N), {}).get(M)
+        if tuned is not None:
+            backend, config = tuned
+            if backend == "dotprod":
+                assert isinstance(config, int)
+                return self.CompileKey(
+                    backend="dotprod", M=M, K=K, bs=config, output_dtype=output_dtype
+                )
+            assert isinstance(config, tuple)
+            split_k, num_stages = config
+            return self.CompileKey(
+                backend="splitk",
+                split_k=split_k,
+                num_stages=num_stages,
+                output_dtype=output_dtype,
+            )
+        if N < _DOTPROD_MAX_N:
+            return self.CompileKey(
+                backend="dotprod", M=M, K=K, bs=_DOTPROD_BS, output_dtype=output_dtype
+            )
+        return super().dispatch(M=M, K=K, N=N, output_dtype=output_dtype)
+
+
+aux_projection_gemm = AuxProjectionGemm()
+
+
+def aux_projection_gemm_accepts(weights: list[torch.Tensor]) -> bool:
+    """Whether ``aux_projection_gemm`` takes every one of ``weights``."""
+    return (
+        bool(weights)
+        and ll_bf16.is_available()
+        and all(
+            w.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and w.dim() == 2
+            and w.is_contiguous()
+            and w.shape[1] % 8 == 0
+            for w in weights
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def warmup_aux_projection_gemms(weights: Iterable[torch.Tensor]) -> None:
+    """Compile the kernels of every row count before graph capture."""
+    shapes = sorted({(w.shape[1], w.shape[0]) for w in weights})
+    aux_projection_gemm.warmup(shapes=shapes, m_values=range(1, LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS + 1))

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Candidate-block selection with ``cooperative_topk`` for decode rows.
+
+`select_candidate_blocks` scores every block of the padded logits row and
+runs ``torch.topk`` over all of them. At long context most of a decode row is
+padding, so here the score kernel also writes each row's valid block count and
+``cooperative_topk`` scans only that prefix.
+
+The selected set of non-negative ids matches `select_candidate_blocks` except
+for which blocks whose fp32 scores tie exactly at the selection boundary are
+kept. ``cooperative_topk`` keeps at most ``k`` (rows of up to 16384 blocks) or
+1024 per cluster CTA (longer rows) candidates of its fp16 boundary bin, so a
+more crowded boundary bin is selected approximately. The pinned newest block is
+kept unless at least ``k`` blocks of the row score NaN or overflow fp16. Rows
+are not sorted and -1 padding may sit anywhere; every consumer of the candidate
+buffer treats a row as a set.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.attention.dsa.candidate_blocks import _max_with_nan
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.indexer_topk import (
+    AUTO_COOPERATIVE_MAX_ROWS,
+    RADIX_TOPK_WORKSPACE_SIZE,
+)
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.v1.worker.workspace import current_workspace_manager
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["width", "nblocks"])
+def _block_scores_kernel(
+    logits,
+    ends,
+    scores,
+    lengths,
+    out,
+    stride_row,
+    stride_col,
+    width,
+    nblocks,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    TILE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    blocks = tl.program_id(1) * TILE + tl.arange(0, TILE)
+    end = tl.load(ends + row)
+    # Blocks from cdiv(end, BLOCK_SIZE) on score -inf and are not pinned, so
+    # the top-k reads only this prefix of the row, the only part stored.
+    limit = tl.minimum((tl.maximum(end, 0) + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) // BLOCK_SIZE, nblocks)
+    if tl.program_id(1) == 0:
+        tl.store(lengths + row, limit.to(tl.int32))
+        # cooperative_topk may leave slots unwritten when its boundary bin
+        # overflows; they must read -1, never a stale block id.
+        for tile in range(0, K, TILE):
+            slots = tile + tl.arange(0, TILE)
+            tl.store(out + row * K + slots, -1, slots < K)
+    offsets = tl.arange(0, triton.next_power_of_2(BLOCK_SIZE))
+    cols = blocks[:, None] * BLOCK_SIZE + offsets[None, :]
+    values = tl.load(
+        logits + row * stride_row + cols * stride_col,
+        (blocks[:, None] < nblocks)
+        & (offsets[None, :] < BLOCK_SIZE)
+        & (cols < end)
+        & (cols < width),
+        other=-float("inf"),
+    )
+    reduced = tl.reduce(values, 1, _max_with_nan)
+    reduced = tl.where(
+        (end > 0) & (blocks == (end - 1) // BLOCK_SIZE), float("inf"), reduced
+    )
+    tl.store(scores + row * nblocks + blocks, reduced, blocks < limit)
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["nblocks"])
+def _finalize_candidates_kernel(
+    out,
+    scores,
+    lengths,
+    nblocks,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    TILE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    cols = tl.program_id(1) * TILE + tl.arange(0, TILE)
+    index = tl.load(out + row * K + cols, cols < K, other=-1)
+    valid = (index >= 0) & (index < tl.load(lengths + row))
+    value = tl.load(
+        scores + row * nblocks + index, (cols < K) & valid, other=-float("inf")
+    )
+    # Only -inf blocks become padding, as in select_candidate_blocks.
+    tl.store(
+        out + row * K + cols,
+        tl.where(valid & (value != -float("inf")), index, -1),
+        cols < K,
+    )
+
+
+def supports_cooperative_candidates(num_rows: int, num_blocks: int, k: int) -> bool:
+    """Whether `select_candidate_blocks_cooperative` takes ``num_rows`` rows of
+    ``num_blocks`` blocks and ``k`` candidates."""
+    return (
+        0 < num_rows <= AUTO_COOPERATIVE_MAX_ROWS
+        and k in (512, 1024, 2048)
+        # cooperative_topk reads the scores with TMA: 16-byte aligned rows.
+        and num_blocks % 4 == 0
+    )
+
+
+def select_candidate_blocks_cooperative(
+    logits: torch.Tensor,
+    row_ends: torch.Tensor,
+    block_size: int,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    """`select_candidate_blocks` for decode rows, on ``cooperative_topk``.
+
+    Args:
+        logits: [rows, width] fp32 logits; row ``i`` is valid below
+            ``row_ends[i]``.
+        row_ends: Contiguous [rows] int32 row lengths in logits columns.
+        block_size: Columns per candidate block.
+        out: Contiguous [rows, k] int32 candidate block ids, -1 padded; see
+            `supports_cooperative_candidates` for the supported shapes.
+
+    """
+    rows, width = logits.shape
+    k = out.shape[1]
+    nblocks = triton.cdiv(width, block_size)
+    assert supports_cooperative_candidates(rows, nblocks, k)
+    assert out.dtype == torch.int32 and out.shape[0] == rows and out.is_contiguous()
+    scores = logits.new_empty((rows, nblocks))
+    lengths = torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device=logits.device)
+    _block_scores_kernel[(rows, triton.cdiv(nblocks, 128))](

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""The sparse-attention indexers in a specialized decode step.
+
+``decode_rows`` runs a dense indexer (``SparseAttnIndexer``) on a copy of the
+varlen decode branch of ``sparse_attn_indexer``, with two additions:
+
+- Row sharding. The indexer is replicated across the TP ranks. In a step of at
+  least ``ROW_SHARD_MIN_REQUESTS`` requests whose count the ranks divide, each
+  rank scores, selects candidates for and top-k's only its contiguous slice of
+  the rows; TP all-gathers of the int32 rows rebuild ``topk_indices_buffer``
+  and, in the candidate source, the candidate blocks.
+- The candidate source selects its candidate blocks with ``cooperative_topk``
+  for up to 64 rows per rank (see ``candidate_topk``).
+
+Steps it does not take run the stock indexer.
+
+``CandidateOverlap`` moves the candidate consumers' candidate expansion and
+sparse MQA-logits schedule onto a side stream.
+
+The row-sharded path issues TP collectives, so its gates read only host state
+that every TP rank shares: the step's row and request counts.
+"""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.attention.dsa.candidate_blocks import (
+    apply_candidate_mask,
+    select_candidate_blocks,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.attention.dsa.sparse_mqa_logits import (
+    candidate_blocks_to_sparse_indices,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.indexer_topk import get_indexer_topk
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.sparse_attn_indexer import (
+    SparseAttnIndexer,
+    as_fp32_logits,
+    kv_cache_as_quant_view,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.sparse_mqa_indexer import SparseMQAIndexer
+from vllm.models.common.ops.sequence_parallel import sp_all_gather
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.attention import DeepseekV4Indexer
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.ops import fused_indexer_q_rope_quant
+from vllm.triton_utils import triton
+from vllm.utils.deep_gemm import (
+    fp8_fp4_paged_mqa_logits,
+    get_paged_mqa_logits_metadata,
+    get_paged_sparse_mqa_logits_metadata,
+    mqa_logits_mx_inputs,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.indexer import (
+    DeepSeekV32IndexerDecodeMetadata,
+    DeepseekV32IndexerMetadata,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.sparse_indexer import (
+    DeepseekV41SparseIndexerMetadata,
+    SparseMQARowsMetadata,
+)
+
+from .candidate_topk import (
+    select_candidate_blocks_cooperative,
+    supports_cooperative_candidates,
+)
+
+# Fewest requests of a row-sharded decode step.
+ROW_SHARD_MIN_REQUESTS = 8
+# Most rows of a step whose candidate expansion overlaps.
+OVERLAP_MAX_ROWS = 16
+
+
+def row_shard_bounds(
+    num_rows: int, num_requests: int, world_size: int, rank: int
+) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
+    """Rows ``[start, end)`` that ``rank`` scores in a pure-decode step, or
+    None when the step stays replicated.
+
+    Each slice holds whole requests of a uniform step; varlen rows are
+    independent, so the split is exact either way. Slices start on an even
+    row: DeepGEMM's paged MQA logits needs its int32 ``indices`` 8-byte
+    aligned. DSpark decode steps always split so; capture and profiling runs
+    of one row a request may not, and stay replicated.
+    """
+    rows = num_rows // world_size
+    if (
+        world_size < 2
+        or num_requests < ROW_SHARD_MIN_REQUESTS
+        or num_requests % world_size
+        or num_rows % num_requests
+        or rows % 2
+    ):
+        return None
+    return rank * rows, (rank + 1) * rows
+
+
+def rope_quant_q(
+    indexer: DeepseekV4Indexer,
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    indexer_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    rotary_emb: nn.Module,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None, torch.Tensor]:
+    """The second half of ``indexer.forward_q``: RoPE and quantize the
+    projected queries ``q`` and scale the per-head ``indexer_weights``."""
+    q_quant, weights = fused_indexer_q_rope_quant(
+        positions,
+        q.view(-1, indexer.n_head, indexer.head_dim),
+        rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+        indexer_weights,
+        indexer.softmax_scale,
+        indexer.n_head**-0.5,
+        use_fp4=indexer.use_fp4_kv,
+        weights_out_dtype=indexer.indexer_weights_dtype,
+    )
+    if isinstance(q_quant, tuple):
+        return q_quant[0], q_quant[1], weights
+    return q_quant, None, weights
+
+
+def _all_gather_rows(local: torch.Tensor, out: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    # The custom all-gather takes floating-point rows and moves the int32
+    # bits unchanged: its Lamport variant rewrites only the INT32_MIN pattern.
+    out.copy_(sp_all_gather(local.view(torch.float32)).view(torch.int32))
+
+
+def decode_rows(
+    op: SparseAttnIndexer,
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    q_quant: torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor],
+    weights: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``op(hidden_states, q_quant, None, weights)`` for a pure-decode step,
+    row-sharded and with cooperative candidates where they apply."""
+    attn_metadata = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+    metadata = (
+        attn_metadata.get(op.k_cache.prefix)
+        if isinstance(attn_metadata, dict)
+        else None
+    )
+    if (
+        not isinstance(metadata, DeepseekV32IndexerMetadata)
+        or metadata.num_prefills > 0
+        or metadata.decode is None
+        # Varlen paged MQA logits without DCP.
+        or metadata.decode.indices is None
+        or metadata.decode.global_seq_lens is not None
+        or not op.skip_k_cache_insert
+    ):
+        return op(hidden_states, q_quant, None, weights)
+    num_rows = metadata.num_decode_tokens
+    tp_group = get_tp_group()
+    bounds = row_shard_bounds(
+        num_rows, metadata.num_decodes, tp_group.world_size, tp_group.rank_in_group
+    )
+    start, end = bounds or (0, num_rows)
+    fast_candidates = (
+        op.candidate_write
+        and op.candidate_blocks is not None
+        and supports_cooperative_candidates(
+            end - start,
+            triton.cdiv(op.max_model_len, op.candidate_block_size),
+            op.candidate_blocks.shape[1],
+        )
+    )
+    if bounds is None and not fast_candidates:
+        return op(hidden_states, q_quant, None, weights)
+
+    q_values, q_scale = q_quant if isinstance(q_quant, tuple) else (q_quant, None)
+    topk_indices_buffer = op.topk_indices_buffer
+    topk_indices_buffer[: hidden_states.shape[0]] = -1
+    _decode_rows(
+        op,
+        q_values,
+        q_scale,
+        weights,
+        metadata.decode,
+        metadata.max_seq_len,
+        start,
+        end,
+        fast_candidates,
+    )
+    if bounds is not None:
+        _all_gather_rows(
+            topk_indices_buffer[start:end, : op.topk_tokens],
+            topk_indices_buffer[:num_rows, : op.topk_tokens],
+        )
+        if op.candidate_write:
+            assert op.candidate_blocks is not None
+            _all_gather_rows(
+                op.candidate_blocks[start:end], op.candidate_blocks[:num_rows]
+            )
+    return topk_indices_buffer
+
+
+def _decode_rows(
+    op: SparseAttnIndexer,
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    q_scale: torch.Tensor | None,
+    weights: torch.Tensor,
+    decode: DeepSeekV32IndexerDecodeMetadata,
+    max_seq_len: int,
+    start: int,
+    end: int,
+    fast_candidates: bool,
+) -> None:
+    """The varlen decode branch of `sparse_attn_indexer` on rows
+    ``[start, end)``: paged MQA logits, candidate selection or mask, and
+    top-k into the same rows of the shared buffers."""
+    assert decode.indices is not None
+    kv_cache = kv_cache_as_quant_view(
+        op.k_cache.kv_cache, op.head_dim, op.use_fp4_cache
+    )
+    seq_lens = decode.seq_lens[start:end]
+    indices = decode.indices[start:end]
+    schedule = decode.schedule_metadata
+    if end - start < decode.seq_lens.shape[0]:
+        # The slice's own schedule; a FULL graph records it.
+        schedule = get_paged_mqa_logits_metadata(
+            seq_lens, kv_cache.shape[1], schedule.shape[0] - 1, indices=indices
+        )
+    q = q[start:end].unsqueeze(1)
+    if op.use_fp4_cache:
+        q = q.view(torch.int8)
+    if q_scale is not None:
+        q_scale = q_scale[start:end].unsqueeze(1)
+    q_scale, decode_weights = mqa_logits_mx_inputs(q, q_scale, weights[start:end])
+    row_ends = seq_lens.view(-1)
+    logits = as_fp32_logits(
+        fp8_fp4_paged_mqa_logits(
+            (q, q_scale),
+            kv_cache,
+            decode_weights,
+            seq_lens,
+            decode.block_table[start:end],
+            schedule,
+            max_model_len=op.max_model_len,
+            indices=indices,
+        ),
+        row_ends,
+    )
+    if op.candidate_blocks is not None:
+        candidates = op.candidate_blocks[start:end]
+        if fast_candidates:
+            select_candidate_blocks_cooperative(
+                logits, row_ends, op.candidate_block_size, candidates
+            )
+        elif op.candidate_write:
+            select_candidate_blocks(
+                logits,
+                None,
+                row_ends,
+                candidates.shape[1],
+                op.candidate_block_size,
+                candidates,
+            )
+        else:
+            apply_candidate_mask(
+                logits, None, row_ends, candidates, op.candidate_block_size
+            )
+    get_indexer_topk(op.topk_backend)(
+        logits,
+        seq_lens,
+        1,
+        op.topk_indices_buffer[start:end, : op.topk_tokens],
+        op.topk_tokens,
+        max_seq_len,
+    )
+
+
+def decode_schedule(
+    op: SparseMQAIndexer,
+    rows: SparseMQARowsMetadata,
+    sparse_block_kv: int,
+    scratch: bool = False,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Expand the decode rows' candidates into ``rows.sparse_indices`` /
+    ``rows.end`` and return their DeepGEMM schedule; the same kernels and
+    inputs as the inline step of `sparse_mqa_logits_paged_decode`. With
+    ``scratch``, expand zero candidates into private outputs instead."""
+    assert rows.block_table is not None and rows.row_indices is not None
+    candidates = op.candidate_blocks[: rows.row_ke.shape[0]]
+    sparse_indices, end = rows.sparse_indices, rows.end
+    if scratch:
+        candidates = torch.zeros_like(candidates)
+        sparse_indices, end = torch.empty_like(sparse_indices), torch.empty_like(end)
+    candidate_blocks_to_sparse_indices(
+        candidates,
+        rows.row_ks,
+        rows.row_ke,
+        op.candidate_block_size,
+        sparse_block_kv,
+        out=(sparse_indices, end),
+    )
+    return get_paged_sparse_mqa_logits_metadata(
+        rows.row_ke,
+        rows.block_table,
+        rows.row_indices,
+        op.k_cache.kv_cache.shape[1],
+        sparse_indices,
+        torch.int8,
+        sparse_block_kv,
+    )
+
+
+class CandidateOverlap:
+    """The candidate consumers' expansion and schedule on a side stream.
+
+    The first candidate consumer of a decode step expands the candidate blocks
+    into DeepGEMM sparse block ids and builds the paged sparse MQA-logits
+    schedule, which later consumers reuse. Neither reads Q, the KV cache or the
+    hidden states, so the candidate source forks them onto ``stream`` once it
+    has written the candidates (``fork``) and every consumer waits for them
+    (``join``) before scoring. The kernels and inputs are those of the inline
+    path, so the outputs match.
+
+    The side stream issues no collectives. The fork waits on the main stream,
+    so a step's writes to the builder's ``sparse_indices`` / ``end`` cannot
+    overtake the previous step's reads, and the schedule allocated on
+    ``stream`` is recorded as used by the main stream.
+
+    DeepGEMM's schedule kernel keeps a per-stream workspace that it creates on
+    first use and refuses to create during a capture, so ``warm`` runs the
+    schedule on ``stream`` once from an eager decode step, on zero candidates
+    and private outputs; the executor forks only after that.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, consumer: SparseMQAIndexer) -> None:
+        self.consumer = consumer
+        self.stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+        self.done = torch.cuda.Event()
+        self.warmed = False
+        self._forked = False
+
+    def _decode_rows(self) -> tuple[SparseMQARowsMetadata, int] | None:
+        attn_metadata = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        metadata = (
+            attn_metadata.get(self.consumer.k_cache.prefix)
+            if isinstance(attn_metadata, dict)
+            else None
+        )
+        if not isinstance(metadata, DeepseekV41SparseIndexerMetadata):
+            return None
+        rows = metadata.sparse_decode
+        if rows is None or not rows.row_ke.numel():
+            return None
+        return rows, metadata.sparse_block_kv
+
+    def warm(self) -> None:
+        """Create the side stream's schedule workspace from an eager step."""
+        found = None if self.warmed else self._decode_rows()
+        if found is None:
+            return
+        main = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+        self.stream.wait_stream(main)
+        with torch.cuda.stream(self.stream):
+            decode_schedule(self.consumer, *found, scratch=True)
+        main.wait_stream(self.stream)
+        self.warmed = True
+
+    def fork(self) -> None:
+        """Start the expansion; the candidate source calls this right after
+        its indexer has written the candidates."""
+        found = self._decode_rows()
+        if found is None or found[0].kernel_metadata is not None:
+            return
+        rows, sparse_block_kv = found
+        main = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+        self.stream.wait_stream(main)
+        try:
+            with torch.cuda.stream(self.stream):
+                schedule = decode_schedule(self.consumer, rows, sparse_block_kv)
+                self.done.record()
+        except BaseException:
+            # Rejoin so that a capture reports this error, not unjoined work.
+            main.wait_stream(self.stream)
+            raise
+        schedule.record_stream(main)
+        rows.kernel_metadata = schedule
+        self._forked = True
+
+    def join(self) -> None:
+        """Make the current stream wait for a pending fork, if any."""
+        if self._forked:
+            torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_event(self.done)
+            self._forked = False
